findings: Field construction alone does not route application menu shortcuts: direct keyDown inserted literal c for Alt+C before native default-menu dispatch was connected.
Recursive view display restores backing-window graphics state even with an explicit image context. Focused editor images were blank until native backing drawing/readback was used.
Actual text editor selection, caret and rendering work with unmapped backing. Logical key-window routing does not acquire compositor focus.
Browser event/model integration remains separate; this checkpoint establishes no browser text adapter.
